Feature: GUI Functional Requirements for Unit U18_GUI

  Scenario: GUI displays FiO2 as measured prior to the patient inhale limb
    Given the system is initialized and running
    When the GUI is displayed
    Then the GUI shows the FiO2 value measured prior to the patient inhale limb

  Scenario Outline: GUI allows setting PIP within the specified range
    Given the system is initialized and running
    When the user sets the PIP to <pip_value> cmH2O
    Then the GUI displays the PIP value as <pip_value> cmH2O
    Examples:
      | pip_value |
      | 5         |  # edge case: minimum value
      | 30        |  # normal case
      | 55        |  # edge case: maximum value
      | 56        |  # invalid case: above maximum
      | 4         |  # invalid case: below minimum

  Scenario: GUI detects controller shutdown
    Given the system is initialized and running
    When the controller is shut down
    Then the GUI displays a "Controller Shutdown" message

  Scenario Outline: GUI allows setting the rise time parameter within the specified range
    Given the system is in <mode> mode
    When the user sets the rise time to <rise_time>% of breath cycle time
    Then the GUI displays the rise time as <rise_time>% of breath cycle time
    Examples:
      | mode       | rise_time |
      | Pressure   | 0         |  # edge case: minimum value
      | Pressure   | 10        |  # normal case
      | Pressure   | 20        |  # edge case: maximum value
      | Pressure   | 21        |  # invalid case: above maximum
      | Pressure   | -1        |  # invalid case: below minimum

  Scenario: GUI allows specifying the assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation mode
    Given the system is initialized and running
    When the user selects the "assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation" mode
    Then the GUI displays the system in "assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation" mode
